cause: Pinned NAX requires macOS>=26.2 and Apple GPU generation>=17 (>=18 phone), and may be disabled at SDK build time. The actual M4 architecture applegpu_g16g independently excludes it. Native enable_tf32 defaults true and was actually true with no relevant env overrides. D256 causal F32 Q>=1024 therefore falls back on this machine.

implementation.public_capability_only: mx::device_info(Device::gpu), already used by apple_environment.mm; no existing architecture parser was found.
implementation.negative_detection: Strict 13-character applegpu_g1[3-6][g/s/d/p] recognition. Missing field, wrong variant, unknown/new identifier, or exception returns false and keeps original native selection.
implementation.scope: Only the otherwise possibly fused D256 causal no-mask path uses this query during cold lowering. All existing GPU-only/Q>=1024/benefit/force-fused guards stay in effect.
implementation.non_changes: No private native declaration in product, no OS/build/env selector duplication, no SDK/kernel patch, no eval/sync during tracing, no hot replay metadata query, no public API/admission/precision-budget change.
implementation.diagnostic_only_private_query: capability.cc forward-declares pinned is_nax_available solely to establish actual SDK behavior; product never uses it.

validation.fresh_compile: Baseline/candidate apple_tensor.cc, current attention_test.cc, and space.cc host TUs only; O3 C++23 arm64 Wall/Wextra/Wpedantic/Werror. Existing SDK/foundation/gtest/metallib reused; no whole configure/build/download/copy.
validation.new_case: F32 D256 BSHD GQA H4/Hkv2 Q1025/KV1281, causal no mask, nonzero QK, independent existing FP64 oracle including one-row tail.
validation.small_controls: Existing D40 fallback, D192 decode, D256 Q17>KV13 causal cases.

space_point.shape: F32 B1/Hq4/Hkv2/D256 Q=KV2048, causal, no mask input; QK0/V1.25.
space_point.measurement: One separate process per arm, same public prepare/create_invocation/bind then clear_cache/reset_peak and submit/wait. Native MLX active/peak/cache only, not process RSS/device-total/private-byte census. Cold prepare is outside peak capture.
space_point.accuracy_interpretation: Both violate the unchanged public helper budget at this large uniform causal shape. Equal max errors do not establish bit parity, full numerical equivalence, or a passing large-shape oracle. This existing accuracy issue remains unresolved.
space_point.allocation_interpretation: The real native counters were collected before exit3 and remain reported as measurements only. Extra peak83,902,464 ->60,371,584 bytes (~28.05% decrease) under current default native settings; caller QKV16MiB/output8MiB listed separately. No mask input.

remaining_limits: Unknown/new architectures retain native selection even if their OS/build/env disables NAX, so those fallback cases may still allocate square scores.
No inference throughput measurement, no strict single-block peak guarantee, no other Apple hardware, no full Apple/Graph suite or HEAD SDK rebuild.
